description: Fit the minimum enclosing circle / ellipse / regular n-gon around the input space.
instructions:
Fits the minimum enclosing shape around the input Space → one output Space.

SHAPES (`shape`)
• circle — smallest circumscribed circle (Welzl). No parameters.
• ellipse — minimum-area enclosing ellipse (Khachiyan). No parameters.
• ngon — regular n-gon with `sides` (3–12); set orientation with `angle`, or tick `optimize` to auto-pick the tightest rotation (hides `angle`).

TIP: use the n-gon for a quick regularised footprint; the circle/ellipse for radial massing, reach analysis, or a bounding envelope. Wire a Space in — the whole boundary is enclosed.
